redCandidate.publicEntry: BattleSimulation.TryFire followed by Tick and EndActiveTurn through the Unity EditMode BattleSimulation harness.
redCandidate.setup: A player fires a 30-damage toxic projectile at one opponent. The scenario observes its real health and poison indicator across the opponent's next two completed turns.
redCandidate.expected: The opponent keeps its post-impact 75 HP when its turn begins, then loses two 5-HP ticks at the end of its two turns and loses the poison status.
redCandidate.observed: The opponent has 69 HP when its turn begins. Unity reports: Expected 75, But was 69.
redCandidate.failureReason: The current implementation applies a fixed 6 damage at the beginning of the poisoned unit's turn, instead of a 20 percent resolved-damage tick at the end of that unit's turn.
